about.title: About Us
paragraphs: Since 2023 we've been on a mission to make professional-grade trading accessible to everyone. We believe in transparency, innovation, and putting our clients first.

risk-disclosure.title: Risk Disclosure
paragraphs: Version 2.0 - Effective September 2026 - Supersedes all prior versions

Trading Contracts for Difference (CFDs), Foreign Exchange (Forex), Precious Metals, Commodities, Market Indices, and Digital Asset Derivatives carries an exceptionally high level of financial risk and can result in the complete loss of all invested capital. These products are complex, highly volatile, and leverage-magnified. You should never invest capital that you cannot afford to lose entirely. You should carefully consider whether trading leveraged derivatives is suitable for your financial circumstances, investment objectives, and risk tolerance.
